verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents single-page scraping, extraction, and a CLI `crawl` command that does a same-domain or sitemap crawl. Those are crawling features, not an instant URL-discovery (site map) capability that lists URLs without fully crawling. No endpoint or option for returning a site's URL list is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it
